craftEvidence.value: Object-level registry was insufficient because one DatabaseConnection could create multiple native SQLite handles while this.db retained only the last one. The fix establishes a one-object/one-active-native-handle invariant, rejects repeated connect before mutation, atomically publishes successful initialization, and closes failed local handles. Every in-process public entry is now either a separate registered object or the single handle of one registered object.

Same public DatabaseConnection double-connect rejects before a second handle, leaves the first prepared read usable until replace, then replace makes its prepared read/write fail. Existing separate-connection public bypass and registered/post-open cases remain covered.
